name: steve-jobs-design-review
tagline_zh: 当你的设计被“太复杂”击中，让乔布斯附体：砍功能、抠细节、问“敢不敢只留一个按钮？”——用他的毒舌，逼出极简。
tagline_en: When your design feels bloated, channel Steve Jobs: cut features, polish details, ask 'dare to keep one.
desc_en: Review designs, products, and features with Steve Jobs'' standards: ruthless simplicity, focus, and end-to-end excellence. Use when the user mentions "Steve Jobs review", "design review", "product review", "what would Steve do", "insanely great", "this feels too complicated", "too many features", "product taste", "saying no", or "is this good enough to ship". Also trigger when critiquing a UI, fea
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的“少即是多”，而是模拟乔布斯的决策树：先砍后问，逼你为每个像素辩护，直到只剩必要。
why_en: Not vague 'less is more'—it simulates Jobs' decision tree: cut first, then defend every pixel, until only the essential survives.
